name: ZamfaraGuard
title: Trust-Weighted Verification of Crowdsourced Conflict Reports Against Disinformation in Zamfara State
institution: Zamfara State (Gusau, Maru, Anka, Tsafe, Zurmi, Shinkafi and 6 other LGAs)
intro: Open reporting lines are attacked with rumours: one false 'they have killed many people, share this' message can start a reprisal. ZamfaraGuard treats every report as evidence of uncertain quality. Each anonymous reporter earns a reputation from past verified reports, reports about the same event are grouped in space and time, independent sources are combined, and copy-paste floods from new SIM cards are flagged. Only well-supported events trigger a dispatch. The rest go to a verifier or stay on watch.
login: verifier / ChangeMe@468 (records true/false verdicts), analyst / ChangeMe@468. Public form at /report.
design: **Beta reputation** per pseudonymous reporter: trust = (1 + confirmed) / (2 + confirmed + false). In the demo, reliable informants reach 0.87 and rumour spreaders fall to 0.11.
**DBSCAN space-time clustering** (5 km and 6 hours) groups reports of one event.
**Noisy-OR credibility** over distinct reporters. The same person repeating counts once.
**Sybil cap**: brand-new numbers together can add at most 0.60 credibility.
**Copy-paste flood detection** with word-set Jaccard similarity. Flagged clusters lose half their credibility.
**Two-source rule**: a dispatch alert needs credibility of at least 0.80 and two independent reporters.
**Privacy**: phones become HMAC pseudonyms and are never stored. Locations are rounded to about 100 m. 4 reports per number per hour.
demo: Run the scenario: real attack in Maru + rumour flood about Gusau
script: Maru: 3 trusted informants, PROBABLE, alert. Gusau: 6 new numbers, same text, flagged, WATCH
Why not believe the Gusau messages?
Flag: near-identical texts from new numbers; credibility 0.30
The verifier checks Gusau: it was false.
Those 6 numbers lose trust for next time
Can one person trigger a dispatch?
commands: Users and 30 days of past reports with verdicts
files: `trust.py` reputation, DBSCAN, credibility, flood detection, verdicts. `app.py` Flask app and map. `geo.py` geography helpers. `main.py` commands and scenario. `selftest.py` tests. `config.json` LGAs and thresholds. `static/leaflet` map library.
extra:
## Data notice

All reports are synthetic. Thresholds (5 km, 6 h, 0.80, 0.60) are starting values to tune with real verified data.
